description: Core EKIP retrieval regression dataset -- Recall@K/Precision@K/MRR/coverage against a small synthetic auth-service-outage corpus (app.evaluation.fixtures.corpus), including one permission-aware pair (same query, different identity permissions, different expected result). Every case is expected_outcome=pass; the two `absence-check`-tagged cases assert that something is correctly NOT retrieved, which is a passing assertion, not an expected-fail negative control.
